mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by > 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which negatively impacts consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by > 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies adjust to lower revenue expectations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies benefit from increased production and efficiency.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by > 2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies face higher costs and lower demand.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines and CPIAUCSL rises concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as companies benefit from increased economic activity and consumer spending.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases by > 1% within a quarter.
